DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通のことでご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss a traffic matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通学路の交差点で、木の枝が信号にかかっています。歩く時に見えにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通学路信号を遮る枝を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At an intersection on the school route, tree branches are covering the signal. It is hard to see when walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report branches blocking a signal on the school route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの交差点でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 図のこの場所です。北側から歩くと、歩行者用の信号に枝が重なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図地点北側と歩行者表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this location on the diagram. When walking from the north, the branches overlap the pedestrian signal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the location on the map, the northern approach, and the pedestrian display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日、ご覧になったのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝です。風が吹くと枝が揺れて、赤か青か確認しづらくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝風で枝が揺れ色判別しづらかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This morning. When the wind blew, the branches swayed, making it difficult to tell whether the light was red or green.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the branches swayed in this morning's wind, making the signal color hard to distinguish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況を伺って担当へ伝えます。どの位置から見えにくかったかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will take down the details and pass them to the department responsible. Please also tell me where you were standing when it was hard to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横断歩道の手前です。車の信号ではなく、歩く人の表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横断歩道手前からの歩行者信号と限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just before the crosswalk. I mean the display for people walking, not the signal for cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify that it was the pedestrian signal viewed from just before the crosswalk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所と表示の種類を確認できました。現場で状況を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have confirmed the location and the type of display. We will check the situation on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもにも、見えない時は無理に渡らず確認するよう伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現場確認に礼を述べ子への確認声かけを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I also tell my child to check carefully and not try to cross when the signal cannot be seen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank them for checking the site and mention reminding your child to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物についてのお尋ねでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転送されて届いた封筒です。送り主へ新しい住所を伝えたいので、元の宛名を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転送封筒の元宛名を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This envelope was forwarded to me. I want to tell the sender my new address, so I would like to check the original address on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the original address on a forwarded envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貼られた表示で見えにくくなっていますね。確認できる部分を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The label attached to it makes it difficult to see. Let us look at the parts we can check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い部屋番号が少し見えます。新しい番号と違うので、送り主はまだ前の住所を使っているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古部屋番号から送主旧住所使用を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see a little of the old apartment number. It is different from the new number, so the sender seems to still be using my previous address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain from the old apartment number that the sender is using your former address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送り主の連絡先は、封筒の裏などにございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are the sender's contact details on the back of the envelope or elsewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏に会社名と電話番号があります。住所変更をその会社へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏の会社連絡先へ住所変更を知らせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a company name and telephone number on the back. I will notify that company of my change of address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will notify the company using the contact details on the back of your change of address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転送と、送り主側の住所変更は別の手続きになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mail forwarding and changing your address with the sender are separate procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうなのですね。転送の届出だけで、会社の記録も変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転送と会社住所変更が別と理解を改める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. I thought submitting a forwarding request would also change the company's records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct your understanding: forwarding and changing your address with the company are separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社側の登録は、その会社へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with the company about the address registered in its records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日電話して、新住所を伝えます。この封筒は、どの郵便だったか分かるよう手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社へ電話し対象郵便の封筒を保管すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call today and give them my new address. I will keep this envelope so I can identify which piece of mail it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will call the company and keep the envelope identifying the mail concerned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 必要な書類についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about the documents you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校へ提出する残高証明が必要です。提出日は来週金曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校へ来週金曜提出の残高証明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a bank balance certificate to submit to my school. The submission date is next Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a balance certificate to submit to school next Friday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 学校から、基準日や形式の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the school specified a reference date or format?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 基準日は月末、紙の原本一通という案内があります。この紙を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月末基準日と紙原本一通の指定資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions specify the last day of the month as the reference date and one original paper copy. I brought this document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the instructions specifying a month-end reference date and one original paper copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指定を確認して、発行に必要な手続きと日数をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the requirements and explain the procedures and number of days needed for issuance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今日申し込むと間に合うか、まず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日申込の間に合う日程確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. First, I would like to check whether it will be ready in time if I apply today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check whether applying today will allow enough time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が受付日と発行予定をご案内します。受け取りは窓口をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member in charge will explain the application acceptance date and expected issuance date. Would you like to collect it at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。郵送ではなく、出来上がったらここへ取りに来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口受取を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than having it mailed, I would like to come here to collect it when it is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you would like to collect it at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 窓口受け取りのご希望も伺います。お持ちの口座を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also note your preference for counter collection. Let us check the account you hold.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座はこちらです。基準日と受取予定日を説明で確かめてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座を示し基準日と受取予定を確認後申込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my account. I will apply after confirming the reference date and expected collection date in your explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your account and say you will apply after confirming the reference date and expected collection date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、発行担当へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to the staff member responsible for issuance. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お惣菜は何になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which prepared dish would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この煮物を、別々の家へ持って行きたいです。二つの容器に分けて買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 煮物を二つの家用容器へ分けて購入できるか頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take this simmered dish to two different homes. Can I buy it divided into two containers?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to buy the simmered dish divided into containers for two homes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、それぞれ何グラムご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. How many grams would you like in each?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは百グラム、もう一つは二百グラムお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百グラムと二百グラムを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One hundred grams in one and two hundred grams in the other, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify one hundred grams and two hundred grams. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分けて量ります。百グラムの方がこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will weigh them separately. This is the one-hundred-gram portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かるように、少ない方のふたへ印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量容器の識別印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you mark the lid of the smaller portion so I can tell them apart?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an identifying mark on the container with the smaller portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに百グラムと書きます。二百グラムの方もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will write one hundred grams here. Please check the two-hundred-gram portion as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認しました。汁があるので、容器を平らにして持ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各量を確認し汁をこぼさない平持ちを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked it. Since there is liquid, I would like to carry the containers level.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm both quantities and say you want to carry them level to avoid spilling the liquid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の底へ二つ並べて入れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will place the two side by side at the bottom of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その入れ方でお願いします。小さい方は近所へ、大きい方は自宅へ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 並べる袋詰めと各配送先を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please pack them that way. I will take the smaller one to a neighbor's home and the larger one to my own home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm side-by-side packing and the destination of each portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広場のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about the plaza?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと柔らかいボールで遊びたいです。ここで使える場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柔球で子と遊べる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to play with a soft ball with my child. Please tell me where we can use it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can play with a soft ball with your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用できる範囲は、こちらの掲示でご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice shows the area where it can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この線の内側ですね。人が多いので、今は空いた端の方で短く遊びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 掲示範囲の空いた端で短時間遊ぶ希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inside this line, then. Since there are many people, I would like to play briefly at an unoccupied edge for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you would like to play briefly at an unoccupied edge within the posted area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲の利用者をご確認ください。休む場所は隣のベンチです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check for other people using the area around you. The bench next to it is where you can rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチで休む時は、ボールを袋へ入れます。水を飲んでからまた遊ぶ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩中ボールを袋へ入れ給水後に再開すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: When we rest on the bench, I will put the ball in a bag. We plan to play again after drinking some water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put the ball in a bag during your break and resume after drinking water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 夕方はこの一帯で清掃が入ります。時間も掲示にございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This whole area will be cleaned in the late afternoon. The time is also on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四時からですね。今は三時なので、三時半には片付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四時清掃の前に三時半片付けを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It starts at four, then. It is three now, so I would like to pack up by three thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to pack up by three thirty before cleaning starts at four. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その予定なら、片付ける時間にも余裕を取れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That schedule should leave you enough time to pack up, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもにも三時半までと伝えました。帰る前にベンチの荷物もまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子へ終了時刻を伝えベンチ荷物をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have also told my child we will finish by three thirty. Before leaving, I will gather our belongings on the bench as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have told your child the finish time and will gather your belongings on the bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、楽しい時間をお過ごしください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの列車をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking up your train home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜、観劇の後に帰ります。日付が変わる頃ですが、金曜と土曜のどちらの時刻表を見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日付跨ぎ帰宅に金曜土曜の時刻表欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will go home after seeing a play tonight. It will be around midnight; should I look at Friday's or Saturday's timetable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to use Friday's or Saturday's timetable for a trip home across midnight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金曜の夜から続く列車は、こちらの金曜の欄でご確認ください。行き先はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: For trains continuing from Friday evening, please check this Friday column. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅までです。舞台は十一時半に終わる予定なので、終電の一つ前も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行先と十一時半終演予定で終電前便も知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: To this station. The play is due to end at eleven thirty, so I would also like to know the train before the last one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your destination and the scheduled eleven-thirty finish, and ask about the train before the last one too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの行き先なら、十一時五十分、その後は零時十五分が最終です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For that destination, there is an eleven-fifty train, followed by the last train at twelve fifteen a.m.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 零時十五分は土曜になっていても、金曜夜の欄なのですね。まず十一時五十分を目標にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 零時十五分の曜日扱いを理解し前便目標を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So even though twelve fifteen a.m. is on Saturday, it is in the Friday-night column. I will aim for eleven fifty first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show you understand which day's column includes twelve fifteen a.m. and decide to aim for the earlier train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 劇場から駅まで歩く時間も見ておくと、予定を立てやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Allowing for the walk from the theater to the station will also help you plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図では十分ほどです。終演後に売店へ寄らず、駅へ向かうつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩十分で売店に寄らず駅へ向かう計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The map says about ten minutes. After the play ends, I plan to head to the station without stopping at the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to walk ten minutes to the station without stopping at the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今夜の表示も、駅に着いた時にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check tonight's display when you arrive at the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二つの発車時刻をメモしました。駅に着いたら行き先と表示を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二時刻を記録し当夜表示と行先を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have written down both departure times. When I reach the station, I will check the destination and display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have noted both times and will check tonight's display and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、観劇をお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy the play. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の案内についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the course information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子育て講座に申し込みました。持ち物の欄に敷物とありますが、大きさの目安はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申込済講座の敷物サイズを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have signed up for the parenting course. The list of things to bring says a mat; is there a recommended size?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the size of the mat for the course you have signed up for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。お子さんも一緒に参加されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Will your child be attending with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、二歳の子と行きます。家にある小さいマットを使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二歳子同伴と自宅小マット利用希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I will go with my two-year-old. I would like to use a small mat we have at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will bring your two-year-old and would like to use your small mat from home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会場では親子で座る予定です。お持ちのマットの大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Parents and children will sit together at the venue. Do you know the size of your mat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一メートル四方です。二人で座れるので、それを持って行こうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一メートル角で親子着席予定を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is one meter square. We can both sit on it, so I am thinking of bringing that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is one meter square and you and your child plan to sit on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その大きさで使えるか、担当者からご案内します。ほかに確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will tell you whether that size is suitable. Is there anything else you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベビーカーを置く場所も聞きたいです。会場の入口は二階と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベビーカー置場と二階入口経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to ask where I can leave the stroller. It says the entrance to the venue is on the second floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about stroller parking and the route to the second-floor entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 置き場所と二階への経路も、担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also pass on your questions about stroller parking and the route to the second floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。マットの確認とベビーカーの案内を聞いて、当日の荷物をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答を聞いて当日荷物を準備すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After hearing about the mat and stroller arrangements, I will get our things ready for the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare your things for the day after hearing the answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、講座の担当へご案内します。ご参加をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to the person in charge of the course. We look forward to your participation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are waiting to see the doctor, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。少しトイレへ行きたいのですが、その間に名前を呼ばれたらどうなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察待ちのトイレ離席と呼出し対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to go to the toilet briefly; what happens if my name is called while I am away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about leaving for the toilet while waiting for an appointment and what happens if you are called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お戻りになったら受付へお知らせください。診察の順番は、その時にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let reception know when you return. We will explain your place in the consultation queue then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の受付票を持って行って、戻ったら見せればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰着時に受付票を見せる方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Should I take this reception slip with me and show it when I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the procedure of showing your reception slip on returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、お持ちください。トイレは奥の右側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please take it with you. The toilet is at the back on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥の右ですね。鞄も一緒に持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: トイレ方向と鞄持参を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: At the back on the right. I will take my bag with me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the direction of the toilet and say you will take your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お戻りになったら、このカウンターへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please come to this counter when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻りました。トイレへ行っていた間に、私の名前は呼ばれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻ったことを告げ不在時の呼出しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am back. Was my name called while I was in the toilet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Announce your return and ask whether you were called while away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先ほどお呼びしました。お戻りを診察室へ伝えて、次のご案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We called you a little while ago. I will tell the consultation room you are back and explain what happens next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ここで待ちます。受付票も手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰着連絡後に受付票を持ち再案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will wait here. I also have my reception slip with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait with your reception slip for further instructions after reporting your return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、もう少々お待ちください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait a little longer. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は反射材の体験に参加されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be taking part in today's reflector demonstration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもの鞄に付ける物を選びたいです。普通の明るい色と、反射する物の違いを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子の鞄用の反射材と明色の違いを実演で見たいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to choose something to attach to my child's bag. I would like to see the difference between an ordinary bright color and something reflective.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a demonstration of the difference between a reflector and a bright color for your child's bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの見本へ光を当てます。同じ位置から、二つを見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will shine a light on these samples. Please compare the two from the same position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右の方が光を強く返していますね。部屋の灯りだけで見た時とは違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 照射時の右見本と室内灯下の違いを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one on the right reflects the light more strongly. It looks different from when I saw it under the room lights alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the difference between the right-hand sample under the directed light and under room lighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 光を返す面の向きによっても見え方が変わります。見本を回してみますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: How it looks also changes with the orientation of the reflective surface. I will turn the sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横向きだと見えにくくなりました。鞄に付ける時も、面が隠れないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 横向きの変化を見て反射面を隠さない配置を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It became harder to see when turned sideways. When attaching one to the bag, I want to make sure the surface is not hidden.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Observe the sideways change and consider placing it so the reflective surface is not hidden. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの鞄では、どこへ付ける予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Where do you plan to attach it on your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後ろの持ち手です。ただ、上着がかぶる時があるので、横にも付ける場所を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち手予定と上着で隠れるため側面候補を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the handle at the back. But a jacket sometimes covers it, so I will also look for a place on the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the handle as your planned position and suggest the side because a jacket may cover it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鞄の形や、着る物と一緒に確認すると分かりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Checking it together with the shape of the bag and the clothes worn should make it easier to judge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で鞄と上着を合わせ、反射する面が外に出る場所を探します。今日は光を当てる実演で違いが分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家で鞄上着を合わせ外向き位置を探すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: At home I will put the bag and jacket together and look for a position where the reflective surface faces outward. Today's demonstration with the light helped me understand the difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the bag with the jacket at home and find an outward-facing position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご参加ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for taking part. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り状を確認します。中身は雑貨と書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check the shipping label. You have written 'miscellaneous goods' for the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人へ手作りのコースターを送ります。もっと詳しく書いた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手作りコースターの送り状雑貨表記を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am sending handmade coasters to a friend. Should I describe them in more detail?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about describing handmade coasters as miscellaneous goods on the shipping label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材質と品物名が分かるようにお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write the material and item name so they can be identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 布製のコースター、六枚と書きます。金属の部品は付いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 布製六枚と金属部品なしを具体記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will write 'six fabric coasters.' They have no metal parts attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify six fabric coasters and no metal parts in the description. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その内容で確認します。箱にはほかの物も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check them on that basis. Is there anything else in the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙のカードが一枚あります。食べ物や電池は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同封紙カードと食品電池なしを答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is one paper card. I have not included any food or batteries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the enclosed paper card and absence of food or batteries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードも添えているのですね。お届け先の住所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have included a card too, then. Please check the delivery address as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この住所と部屋番号で合っています。電話番号は友人から教えてもらった物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先部屋番号と提供電話番号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This address and apartment number are correct. The telephone number is the one my friend gave me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the destination, apartment number, and telephone number provided to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。送り状を貼る前に、控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. I will give you your copy before attaching the shipping label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを受け取りました。品物を具体的に書けたので、この箱を発送してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを受領し具体記入済み箱の発送を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the copy. Now that I have described the items specifically, please ship this box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge receiving your copy and ask to ship the box with the detailed description completed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly, we will take it. Thank you.
